source.method: arXiv:2512.05349 Eqs. (1)–(2) (relative representation); PCA; orthogonal Procrustes onto the medium map

source.equivalence: Atoms with identical (element, distance) lists within 25 Å are one environment
source.reflection: z → −z (mirror through the xy plane); for crystals two cell vectors swapped to keep the cell right-handed
source.box: Molecules in a 20 Å periodic box for CHGNet, SevenNet and Orb (not for MACE, which needs no cell)
source.lattice_note: Lattice constants are inputs (rounded experimental values), not results.
